{{Quote|Sir, with the death of Senator Kharrus, are you now in command of the mission?''"<br />"''Technically&hellip;no.''"<br />"''Then, uh&hellip;who is?''"<br />"''Representative Binks is the highest-ranking person here.|A clone trooper and Stone, after their crash-landing on Florrum|audio=StoneNotInCommand-TGG.flac|<ref name="TGG" />}}
'''Stone''', designated by the number '''CC-5869''', was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Stone, together with some of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] Guard [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]], and the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], were [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|sent]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] group was to deliver a ransom in the form of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] leader [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], who was holding captive the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. However, they were betrayed by some of the pirates, and their [[Kharrus's Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was shot down over Florrum, where the [[Hondo's complex/Legends|pirate base]] was located.

The impact of the crash [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle's]] two [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilots]] and Kharrus, leaving Binks as the highest-ranking [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. Although the group was attacked by the pirates and initially lost the ransom, Binks, Stone, and their men chased down the pirates and retrieved the spice by killing nearly all the pirates in a [[Lightfight|blasterfight]]. However, when the Republic group reached the pirate base, Dooku had already escaped. Stone, his [[Squad/Legends|squad]], and Binks, along with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;who had also been captured by the pirates&mdash;then left Florrum in the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]].

==Biography==
===Crashed on Florrum===
{{Quote|Incoming! Form a circle!|Stone, during the pirates' attack|<ref name="TGG" />}}
[[File:Clones_jar_jar.png|thumb|left|250px|Stone with Binks on Florrum]]
CC-5869,<ref name="VGUB" /> who took on the name Stone, was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TGG" /> Like all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Stone was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and trained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="CE" /> During the war, [[Gender/Legends|he]] served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Diplomatic Escort Group]], a branch of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]].<ref name="VGUB" /> Stone was often tasked with guarding senior Republic officials on dangerous missions to worlds near the front lines.<ref name="CE" /> He spent long stretches of the Clone Wars far from the front while on Coruscant, and his primary responsibility was protecting the planet and its institutions, leaders and [[Coruscanti/Legends|people]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{SWE|characters|clone-commander-stone|Clone Commander Stone}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TCWdates">{{TCWdates|112}}</ref> the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] leader [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] captured [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and demanded a ransom of one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in the form of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] from the Republic in exchange for the Count.<ref name="Dooku Captured">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] subsequently dispatched [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], under escort by Stone and some of his [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], to [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|deliver]] the ransom to Ohnaka's [[Hondo's complex/Legends|headquarters]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name="TGG" />

After arriving in a [[Kharrus's Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Florrum, Kharrus contacted the Chancellor and informed him of the progress of the mission before buckling up for the landing. However, [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]], a member of [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka's gang]], betrayed Ohnaka and ordered fellow pirate [[Barb Mentir/Legends|Barb Mentir]] to shoot down the Republic [[Starship/Legends|ship]] so that they could take the spice for themselves. Mentir, in a [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class]] vessel, managed to shoot down the Republic [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crashed into the [[Doshar fields/Legends|Doshar fields]], and the impact [[Death/Legends|killed]] both of the shuttle's [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] and Kharrus, leaving Binks as the highest ranking [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and therefore commander of the group. While Binks buried the dead Senator, two of Stone's [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] tried to repair the shuttle's [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] in order to contact the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] but were unable to make it work. Shortly thereafter, Binks spotted Falso and several fellow pirates approaching on [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bikes, and while Stone believed that the pirates would try to negotiate the ransom, the pirates attacked the clone troopers. Stone ordered his troops into a defensive circle, and the pirates cut the clones off from their crashed ship. Outnumbered, Stone, Binks, and their troops retreated into one of the surrounding [[Acid/Legends|acid]] [[Geyser/Legends|geysers]].<ref name="TGG" />

===Serving under a Gungan===
{{Quote|He's probably gonna get himself killed.''"<br />"''Don't worry. He's smarter than he looks.|A trooper and Stone, on Binks|<ref name="TGG" />}}
[[File:StoneWeequayHostage-TGG.png|thumb|right|250px|Stone holds a Weequay pirate at gunpoint.]]
During their stay in the geyser, Binks discovered that the planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Skalder/Legends|skalders]] were able to detect the geysers' bursts of acid. After the pirates left, Stone and the group returned to the shuttle, only to find that the spice had been stolen by Falso. While Stone proposed that they wait for a rescue party to arrive before doing anything else, Binks insisted on pursuing the pirates using the skalders as mounts, which the group did. The clones soon caught up to the pirates ahead and managed to kill most of them in the ensuing [[Lightfight|firefight]]. After recovering the spice, one of Stone's troopers scanned the landscape with [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] for the pirate base. When the group sighted some energy lines, Stone decided to follow them in order to find the base. Along the way, Binks spotted several [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|pirate tanks]], and the group quickly halted and took cover. Stone then sent Binks to "negotiate" with the pirates who were [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] the [[Tank/Legends|tanks]]. While speaking with the pirates, Binks climbed up onto one of the tanks and accidentally drove the vehicle into an energy line, collapsing it. In the ensuing chaos, Stone saved Binks by stopping a pirate from shooting him, before congratulating Binks on his "success." The clones managed to capture all of the tanks and proceeded to the enemy base.<ref name="TGG" />

Stone, Binks, and the troopers arrived at the pirate base just in [[Time/Legends|time]] to find [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;who had been sent earlier to Florrum and had just escaped captivity from Ohnaka, who had attempted to ransom them to the Republic&mdash;holding Ohnaka at [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] point. Kenobi ordered Stone to power up the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] of the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] ship, while Kenobi released Ohnaka and told him that he held no grudge against him in spite of his crimes against them. Because Dooku had escaped, Stone, his troopers, Binks and the two Jedi left Florrum in the ''Twilight'' with their retrieved spice ransom.<ref name="TGG" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I suggest we stay here and wait for the Republic to send a rescue party.|Stone|<ref name="TGG" />}}
[[File:Stone-TCW.png|thumb|right|180px|Stone in full armor]]
While [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Stone's post in the Coruscant Guard was prestigious, it was nonetheless frustrating for a clone trained for war. Stone's training never prepared him for having a Gungan [[Politics/Legends|politician]] as his superior,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and though he found the idea of taking orders from Jar Jar Binks to be ridiculous,<ref name="CE" /><ref name="TGG" /> he nevertheless followed the chain of command.<ref name="CE" /><ref name="TGG" /> Despite being very skeptical about Binks's leadership abilities,<ref name="CE" /> Stone recognized the Gungan's skills during the mission and saved his life twice.<ref name="TGG" />

After their shuttle crashed on Florrum, Stone remained rather passive, preferring to wait for a rescue party instead of following the pirates in pursuit of the stolen spice ransom. He nevertheless set out with Binks and his men to go after the pirates,<ref name="TGG" /> making use of his combat skills in the process.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Stone obeyed the orders given to him, regardless of whether they came from Binks or [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] Obi-Wan Kenobi.<ref name="TGG" />

The commander was recognizable by a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on the left side of his forehead, which resembled the number "58." Stone had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], tan skin,<ref name="TGG" /> and stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="CE" />

==Skills and abilities==
Stone was trained in both armed and [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]], [[Scout/Legends|recon]], and military tactics. He could also utilize a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]].<ref name="CE" />

==Equipment==
In combat, Stone wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]]<ref name="TGG" /> painted in the red [[Color/Legends|colors]] of his unit, the Coruscant Guard.<ref name="CE" /> During the mission to Florrum, he was equipped with two [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 blaster pistols]].<ref name="TGG" /> Stone also used a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] during the war.<ref name="CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Being an accurate shot with a blaster is going to get you through more tough scrapes than you can imagine out there on the front lines. You can keep your marksmanship skills sharp, here at the blaster training range. If you're interested, I'll fire up the program for you.|Stone|<ref name="CWA">{{TCWA|loc=Training Room}}</ref>}}
Stone first appeared in "[[The Gungan General]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. Although not identified in the episode itself, he was named in the corresponding [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|online guide]] on [[StarWars.com]]. Stone, like all clone troopers in the series, was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="gg guide" /> Stone later received the designation "CC-5869" in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Visual Guide Ultimate Battles'']].<ref name="VGUB" />

Stone also appears in ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', a [[2011]] [[Canon|non-canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] that features a comical adaptation of "The Gungan General."<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> The commander further appears as a non-playable character in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], a [[2010]] video game by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. In the game, Stone can be found in the Training Room, where he serves as an instructor for blaster training.<ref name="CWA" />
